entries.name: Overhead camshaft engine
entries.definition: A piston engine whose camshaft sits in the cylinder head, above the valves, and operates them directly or through short rockers.

entries.name: Overhead cost analysis
entries.definition: Examining a business's indirect costs, such as rent, utilities and administration, and how they are allocated to products or departments.

entries.name: Overhead crane operation
entries.definition: Operating an overhead or bridge crane, which runs on rails above a work area, to lift and move loads.

entries.name: Overhead valve engine
entries.definition: A piston engine whose valves sit in the cylinder head and are operated by pushrods from a camshaft in the engine block.

entries.name: Oxidation processes
entries.definition: Chemical processes in which a substance loses electrons or combines with oxygen, such as those used in water treatment, metal finishing and chemical manufacturing.

entries.name: package.json
entries.definition: The manifest file of a Node.js project, written in JSON, that records the project's name, version, dependencies and scripts.

entries.name: Packaging machine operation
entries.definition: Setting up, running and monitoring machines that fill, seal, wrap or label products for packaging.

entries.name: Padrino
entries.definition: A Ruby web framework built on top of Sinatra that adds helpers, generators and a modular structure.

entries.name: Page layout
entries.definition: Arranging text, images and other elements on a page or screen so that it is clear and visually balanced.

entries.name: Pallet building
entries.definition: Stacking and securing goods on a pallet so that they can be stored or shipped.

entries.name: Palm OS
entries.definition: An operating system for handheld computers (PDAs) and early smartphones, developed by Palm.

entries.name: pandas
entries.definition: A Python library for data analysis that provides DataFrame and Series structures for loading, cleaning, transforming and summarising tabular data.

entries.name: Pandemic preparedness
entries.definition: The planning and measures that prepare a health system, workplace or community to respond to a pandemic.

entries.name: Paperwork Reduction Act
entries.definition: A US federal law that requires agencies to minimise the paperwork burden on the public and to get approval from the Office of Management and Budget before collecting information.

entries.name: Parallel computing
entries.definition: Dividing computation into work performed concurrently.

entries.name: Parasympathetic nervous system
entries.definition: The part of the autonomic nervous system that slows the heart and promotes rest-and-digest functions such as digestion.

entries.name: Paris Agreement
entries.definition: The 2015 international climate treaty in which countries agreed to hold global warming well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels and to pursue 1.5 degrees.

entries.name: Parrot AR.Drone
entries.definition: A quadcopter drone made by Parrot that is flown from a smartphone or tablet.

entries.name: Partnership taxation
entries.definition: The tax rules for partnerships, under which income and losses pass through to the partners, covered in the US by Subchapter K of the Internal Revenue Code.

entries.name: Passport.js
entries.definition: Authentication middleware for Node.js, with strategies for usernames and passwords, OAuth providers and other login methods.

entries.name: Path to purchase
entries.definition: The steps a customer goes through from first becoming aware of a product to buying it.

entries.name: Pathlore
entries.definition: A learning management system, from Pathlore Software Corporation, for delivering and tracking employee training.

entries.name: Pathology informatics
entries.definition: The field that applies information technology and data science to pathology and laboratory medicine, including lab information systems and digital pathology.

entries.name: Patient coordination
entries.definition: Arranging a patient's appointments, services and information across a care team so that care runs smoothly.

entries.name: Patient education
entries.definition: Teaching patients and their families about a condition, treatment or self-care so that they can manage their health.

entries.name: Patient identification and matching
entries.definition: Accurately identifying a patient and linking all of their records across health-care systems to the right person.

entries.name: Patient transfer
entries.definition: Moving a patient safely from one place to another, such as from bed to wheelchair or between care facilities, using correct lifting and equipment.

entries.name: Pattern Lab
entries.definition: An open-source tool for building and showing atomic-design pattern libraries (style guides) for websites.

entries.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
entries.definition: A set of security requirements, from the PCI Security Standards Council, for organisations that store, process or transmit payment card data.

entries.name: PDF conversion
entries.definition: Converting documents to and from PDF and other formats such as Word, Excel and images.

entries.name: PDF generation
entries.definition: Creating PDF files from other content or data, often automatically by software.

entries.name: PDF.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library from Mozilla that displays PDF documents in the browser.

entries.name: PDF viewer
entries.definition: Software that opens and displays PDF files for reading and printing, and often for annotating.

entries.name: PDFlib
entries.definition: A commercial library, with bindings for many programming languages, for generating and processing PDF files.

entries.name: PDFNet
entries.definition: A software development kit from PDFTron (now Apryse) for creating, viewing, editing and converting PDF files.

entries.name: PDFtk
entries.definition: A command-line tool, short for PDF Toolkit, for merging, splitting, rotating and encrypting PDF files.

entries.name: Peachtree Accounting
entries.definition: Accounting software for small businesses, originally from Peachtree Software and later sold by Sage as Sage 50.

entries.name: Pediatric surgery
entries.definition: The surgical specialty that operates on infants, children and adolescents.

entries.name: Pelvic floor
entries.definition: The muscles and connective tissue at the base of the pelvis that support the bladder, bowel and, in women, the uterus.

entries.name: Pelvic floor rehabilitation
entries.definition: Therapy, such as exercises and biofeedback, that retrains the pelvic floor muscles to treat problems like incontinence and pelvic pain.
